title: scale websockets nodejs
linkedin:
> You need two things.

First, **sticky sessions** at the load balancer, so a client's handshake and its subsequent connection land on the same instance. Second, a **Redis pub/sub adapter** so instances can broadcast to each other, since a message emitted on instance A must reach sockets held by instance B. With Socket.IO that's `@socket.io/redis-adapter`.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/scale-websockets-nodejs/
